headline: Stonecradle Erupts as Dead Lands Fighting Quickens
war_summary: Three hours beyond our last edition, fresh fires burn across the map. Stonecradle, dormant at our previous writing, now tops the two-hour casualty ledger — better than 1,800 fallen in two hours' fighting, the returns still climbing, the post at The Long Fast fought over thirteen times in a day, with the Wardens holding eight of its nine works. The Dead Lands knows no respite: four base actions inside two hours, Callahan's Boot again the busiest ground, Warden losses running near 590 an hour and quickening. Stlican Shelf remains in flux; five actions in six hours have left the Colonials six works against the Wardens' three, a gain of one since we last wrote. Weathered Expanse, the day's busiest field in our former column, has logged no base change in seven hours, though its casualty lists stay heavy while cooling; Godcrofts' evening flare has likewise died down. Marban Hollow saw action at Mox within the hour, and Callahan's Passage casualties now accelerate sharply even though no fresh base reports have come. On our count the Colonials hold 266 strategic works to the Wardens' 169, one base left in no-man's-land. It is the war's one-hundred-fifty-fifth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
